LESSON: WRITING 2.3.1 LETTER WRITING.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Writing 2.3.1 Letter writing.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 2.3.1 Letter writing., part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which writing materials can we use to write letters? 2. Other than writing, how else can we create letters?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 2.3.1 Letter writing. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: writing skills as learner performs different activities in number writing (modeling,

coloring, writing).

● Learning to learn: learning independently skills as learner learns to write letters of alphabet

Values:
● Responsibility: Diligence as learner write letters of the alphabet without assistance.

● Integrity: Honesty as learner shows accountability in commitment to complete tasks given.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Personal hygiene as learner washes hands with clean water and soap after a modeling activity.

● Social cohesion as learner works with others to model letters.

Link to other Activity Areas.

Learner relates modeling letters of the alphabet with modeling in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, Signed audio visual story clips, books, flash cards, online resources, video games, charts, pictures,

relevant digital devices.
